dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL student program; uses LINE SEQUENTIAL, ASSIGN TO PRINTER, SORT/MERGE verbs, ACCEPT FROM DATE YYYYMMDD — consistent with GnuCOBOL on a PC (LENEVO-PC in SOURCE/OBJECT-COMPUTER)

purpose.domain_detail: Product inventory management across three warehouses (NV10, CA20, WA30) and seven vendors
purpose.summary: This batch program reads three unsorted inventory input files (one per warehouse), sorts each by warehouse/vendor/product ID, merges them into a single sorted file, validates records, and produces a formatted summary report showing product details, costs, and subtotals at product, vendor, warehouse, and grand-total levels. It also writes invalid records to an error file.

notable_features: SORT verb with USING/GIVING on three separate files
MERGE verb combining three sorted files
OCCURS 5 TIMES for product data within a record
REDEFINES used for vendor lookup table with INDEXED BY
ASSIGN TO PRINTER for report and error output
ACCEPT FROM DATE YYYYMMDD for current date
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File is named 'sbanjara_Program4.cbl' indicating a student submission (author SBANJARA). Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the procedure division is cut off mid-sentence. No COMP-3 usage despite numeric accumulators. LENEVO-PC (likely typo for LENOVO-PC) in CONFIGURATION SECTION confirms PC/GnuCOBOL environment.
